### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **12** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks`, `@objectstack/service-messaging`, `@objectstack/service-realtime`, `@objectstack/service-storage`, `@objectstack/types`, touching **25** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **27** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/es-ES.source-hashes.generated.ts`, `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/ja-JP.source-hashes.generated.ts`, `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.source-hashes.generated.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**40** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d34aa58a2affc87ded426dc6a326edb03534cb62`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **27** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/es-ES.source-hashes.generated.ts`, `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/ja-JP.source-hashes.generated.ts`, `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.source-hashes.generated.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os dev (command, 30 pages)`, `os validate (command, 53 pages)`
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **53** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d34aa58a2affc87ded426dc6a326edb03534cb62` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a1c3b19e9816815cd7a86ecba8fd899d2b2bf0d9` — the merge of head `9d5f33f929c84d99ddadedc9b6a94c98909977f6` into base `d34aa58a2affc87ded426dc6a326edb03534cb62`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a1c3b19e9816815cd7a86ecba8fd899d2b2bf0d9 && git checkout a1c3b19e9816815cd7a86ecba8fd899d2b2bf0d9
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d34aa58a2affc87ded426dc6a326edb03534cb62 9d5f33f929c84d99ddadedc9b6a94c98909977f6 && git checkout -B drift-repro d34aa58a2affc87ded426dc6a326edb03534cb62 && git merge --no-ff 9d5f33f929c84d99ddadedc9b6a94c98909977f6

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d34aa58a2affc87ded426dc6a326edb03534cb62
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs d34aa58a2affc87ded426dc6a326edb03534cb62` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9d5f33f929c84d99ddadedc9b6a94c98909977f6`
Local-runs: none

Reviewed against the card (#20752 body and all six comments), the governing ruling `5902360492` on #20513, the precedents (PR #20795, #21139, the fold ACCEPT `5892713504`, commit `6bff748bbd`), the PR body as re-read from the API, the 51-file net diff `git diff e35c40a525..refs/review/pr-21172` (+99 / −137), every cited card or its landing commit, and the head's check-runs. ⛔ Not the dispatch order, not the seat's conclusions.

**Check-runs on the head, converged:** 35 distinct names (42 runs collapsed latest-per-name), all `completed`, all on `9d5f33f929`: 31 `success`, 4 `skipped` (Auto Label, Check PR Size, Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)), 0 failed. `Lint & Repo Gates` and the `Test Core` rollup were the last two to land, both `success`. The earlier head `c023fa0d00` is ignored as instructed.

**Merge-tree:** `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main refs/review/pr-21172` against a freshly fetched `origin/main` (`d34aa58a2a`) is clean: tree `45d7e0103d`, exit 0. `origin/main` is 2 commits past the PR's base `e35c40a525`; neither touches a file this PR touches, and the ledger at `origin/main` is byte-identical to the base's.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) Form D, string by string — holds.** Every one of the 32 tracker citations was read against its card or, for the three 404s, its landing commit, and each rewritten sentence states what was actually decided without inventing a decision:
- `compile.ts:753` / `validate.ts:689` (3366): the card's title is literally "preflight that required capabilities have an installable provider in the current edition". Accurate.
- `compile.ts:824` (3786): the landing changeset `8186a705f0` says "It never rejects" and keeps the schemas non-strict; `compile.ts` has no strict path on these warnings (`--strict-body` is about callable bodies). "reported here, never refused" is accurate for the `os build` header.
- `db/clean.ts:33` (6469): the fix `bd5fc3855d` unified the three commands' default-database resolution. Accurate.
- `doctor.ts:1406` (2377): `referenceFilters` was removed in the follow-up slice of the ADR-0049 removal (`5051634768`), as a key with no runtime consumer. Accurate; the ADR id is a customer-resolvable reference the gate keeps.
- `meta/resync.ts:71` (8692, 404): changeset of `712e185db` — the seeder now stamps `managed_by: 'platform'`, forward only, pre-existing rows deliberately not migrated. "on installs created before the seeder began stamping its default sets 'platform'" is accurate.
- `meta/resync.ts:104` (2705): ruling B (`4931819087`) — boot stays insert-once, resync overwrites platform-owned rows. Accurate.
- `migrate/duplicates.ts:859` (8725): ruling B (`5377374267`) — the report lands on `os migrate duplicates`, `os migrate plan`'s drift contract untouched. Accurate. `:861` (8686): ruling `5299880350` shape 2 — a one-shot boot-time backfill stamps untenanted seed rows with the install's organization. Accurate. `:858` (8928): citation only; the third sentence already states "never renumbers, deduplicates or rewrites anything", which is binding point 3 of `5302919977`.
- `migrate/multi-value-columns.ts:332` (11535): route C (`5405686794`) — warn and ship an operator-run migration, never alter a production table unattended. Accurate.
- `migrate/recorded-by.ts:69` (4556): ruling in `5161102937` — nullable lookup, system-initiated writes store null. Accurate.
- `migrate/summary-nulls.ts:81` (5749): ACCEPT `5206990154` — insert initialises count/sum to 0. Accurate.
- `serve.ts:4393` (3963): the card's decision A1 — `api.requireAuth` removed, anonymous deny unconditional, auth-less stack refused at boot. "always denied, with no setting that turns that off" is accurate.
- `serve.ts:5952-5953` and `node.ts:393` (4719): `02dc076927` gated host resolution on the declaration because NODE_PATH reachability made the outcome depend on how the process was launched. The serve.ts sentence now says that; the node.ts sentence already did (citation only). Accurate.
- `storage/orphans.ts:173` (10950): ruling `5386673556` 「10950 不考虑存量」, closed not-planned, forward fix #10240 in place. "was decided against: deletes no longer strand files, and files stranded before that fix are left in place" is accurate; the old "deferred decision" was the stale claim.
- `test/helpers/serve-process.ts:569` (13062): `4f9df8f782` — serve publishes the port it BOUND. Accurate. `:546` (12525): citation only; the sentence already states the ruling's "a silent skip is the same false green".
- `cloud-connection-route-ledger.ts:205/228/238/248` (8976): `e0695b5823` gated the four mutating install-local doors on `manage_metadata` and dropped the any-session/`x-user-id` acceptance. "never merely a signed-in session" is accurate, on exactly those four rows. `:215` (9011, 404): changeset of `01074e5512` — `installedBy` is a platform user id, `storageDir` a host filesystem path, both narrowed to `manage_metadata` holders. Accurate. `:264` (11863): `d18ae69f9f` gave trigger-api's host-mounted hook route its own ledger row. Accurate.
- `types/src/node.ts:383-384` (10943, 404): changeset of `46d34ab7c` — the fallback resolves from the caller once `fallbackImport` is passed. Accurate.
- Citation-only sites (`dev.ts:233` 5148, `doctor.ts:221` 5673, `doctor.ts:1544` 5397, `serve.ts:6021` 4818, `storage-driver.ts:149/:349` 3276): each sentence already states the decision its card recorded (restart after rebuild; unset NODE_ENV reads as production; doctor loads config under serve's `.env*` cascade; the degraded-tenancy escape covers absence not mount refusal; a guessed default would write to a database the operator never named). Dropping only the number is the lane precedent (PR #20795: "where the sentence already stated what was decided, only the citation goes").
- The header literal `i18n-extract.ts:2354` (12069, 8765): `source-hash.ts` records the ruled shape verbatim — "a hash mismatch marks the translation stale, and stale falls back to the source text" (#8765 B), extended to the generated half (#12069 A). "a leaf whose digest no longer matches its source is stale and serves the source text instead" states both. Accurate; `09b4f4e4e` kept as provenance.

**(b) Text only — holds.** Every hunk in the 18 hand-edited `.ts` files is inside a string literal; the re-split concatenations preserve their spacing; no exit code, error `code`, flag, field, HTTP status, export or control flow moves. The three `serve.ts` colours `#111`/`#666`/`#444` → `#111111`/`#666666`/`#444444` are rendering-identical by CSS short-hex expansion, and the gate's own docblock names 3-digit all-numeric colours as its measured false-positive family with "the remedy is the 6-digit colour spelling" (its failure text: "Spell it 6-digit"). The three rows were ledger entries, not tracker ids; respelling is the right disposition, not a hand-edit of the baseline.

**(c) The ledger — holds.** Computed from the JSON at both ends: base `e35c40a525` (= `fde553c509` = `origin/main`) 621 occurrences / 428 pairs / 169 files, cli 29, cloud-connection 6, types 2; head 584 / 395 / 152, all three at 0. Row-level comparison: 0 pairs added, 0 counts changed, exactly the 17 files' rows removed (33 pairs, 37 occurrences). The diff is 67 deleted lines and none added across the two recompute commits. Only shrinkage; no other row moves; no gate added or loosened (no change under `scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs`).

**(d) The patch round — holds.** The header literal is in form D (above). The 27 companions: 27 files, 27 hunks, every hunk `@@ -5,7 +5,7 @@`, one distinct removed line and one distinct added line across all 27, and the added line equals the producer's literal — the same shape `6bff748bbd` and the fold ACCEPT recorded for the earlier regeneration. The three doc transcripts (`cli.mdx:608`, `validating-metadata.mdx:699`, `react-pages.mdx:393`) now read `  → Checking that every required capability has a provider installable in this edition...`, byte-identical to `printStep`'s `  → ${msg}` over the new literal. No `content/docs/releases/**` path is in the diff. No changeset for the 9 companion packages: the changed line is a JSDoc comment in a generated source file, so no published API moves whatever the bundler keeps; the dev's dist measurement (0 hits) is consistent with that and not re-run here.

**(e) Pins — holds.** `resync-skip-explanation.test.ts:44` asserts `before the seeder began stamping its default sets 'platform'`, a substring of the new `resync.ts` literal; `build-json-undeclared-key-parity.e2e.test.ts:288` asserts the exact new header. Both ablation reports (1 failed / N passed with the phrase replaced, restore blob equal to HEAD) are consistent with pins that can fail; not re-run. Grep of every old sentence across the head tree: no test asserts an old string. The e2e docblock at `:12` is a transcript "Measured at `origin/main` 4ceae8ab0" — a dated measurement, rightly left. Other residual quotes are comments or out-of-stage runtime strings (`plugin-dev/dev-plugin.ts:934` 3963 and `runtime/standalone-stack.ts` 3276 are stages 4 and 3; `verify/harness.ts` 4719 is stage 4).

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/cli` `patch`, `@objectstack/types` `patch`, `Clause-②: no` in the changeset and the PR body — right: author-visible text only, no authorable surface, export or envelope field moves. The changeset's note that a script matching the old step line needs the new spelling is a fair consumer note for a patch, as PR #20795's stage took. **No `@objectstack/cloud-connection` entry — verified:** `src/index.ts` does not import `cloud-connection-route-ledger.ts` (its only importer is the conformance test), the root `tsup.config.ts` entry is `src/index.ts` alone, and `package.json` `files` is `dist` + README + CHANGELOG, so the ledger notes never reach the published artifact. The departure from the dispatch's changeset list is correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviations, both rounds:** (1) the `i18n-extract.ts` hold was answered A by the claim amendment `5931899236` and carried in this stage — done. (2) the `cloud-connection` changeset omission — verified above. (3) the three CSS colours — the gate's documented remedy, rendering-identical. (4) `orphans.ts` "decided against" — accurate to the not-planned close and `5386673556`; the ruling's "reopening is free if it starts mattering" is not contradicted by stating the decision as made. (5) the e2e docblock at `:12` — a dated measurement, rightly kept. (6) the cli integration tier not re-run after the merge — the merge brought `start.ts` and a nightly e2e file sharing no file with this PR, and the head's Test Core shards are green; accepted.
- **#20594 fold sites in this stage:** `cli` `meta/resync.ts:71` and `types` `node.ts:383/:393` are both rewritten in form D — done. The four "open-pointer sites" the fold ACCEPT named (`init.ts:267`, `plugin/publish.ts:131`, `utils/osplugin.ts:21/:49`) are `//` and docblock comments at the head, not ledgered strings; they are outside this card's runtime-string scope and the stage-1 claim, and stay where the fold left them. Not a blocker.
- **Residual quote, non-blocking, for the seat:** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json:1009` illustrates the `--verbose` prescription with `'Use lookupFilters … removed in #2377'`; its `verify` clause tests the dim `→` lines, not that text, so no runner fails on it, but the example now mis-quotes the live prescription. One-line follow-up on a later stage or the checklist's next pass. `packages/spec/src/cron-typed-positions-retirement.test.ts:56` quotes the old header inside a measured-transcript comment — a dated record, not a pin.
- **Closing keyword:** the body opens `Part of #20752`, no closing keyword; `Part-of PR must not also close its card` is green. Right, since stages 2–5 remain on the card.
- **Governed paths:** none of the 51 files is under `docs/adr/`, `.claude/`, `skills/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` or `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` (the `GOVERNED_SURFACES` register at the head); `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green. The PR is draft with `mergeable_state: blocked`, as expected before this record.
